abstract: Inflammatory cell infiltration was characterized in five classical seminomatous testicular tumours using immunohistochemical techniques. These cells of immunological lineage were sited mostly around vessels. Lymphocytes were the most numerous, T cells outnumbering B cells in all sections studied. The helper/inducer subgroup predominated in the T cell family with suppressor cells more common than cytotoxic cells. Plasma cells constituted only a small percentage of this population as did natural killer cells. No Langerhans cells were identified. Phagocytic macrophages were twice as common as antigen-presenting macrophages yet T lymphocytes were 15 times more common than these antigen-presenting macrophages.
abstract_ja: 古典的なセミノーマ性精巣腫瘍5例における炎症性細胞浸潤を、免疫組織化学的手法を用いて検討した。これらの免疫系細胞は主に血管周囲に認められた。リンパ球が最も多く、T細胞はB細胞を上回った。T細胞群ではヘルパー/誘導サブグループが優勢で、サプレッサー細胞は細胞傷害性細胞よりも多く認められた。形質細胞は少数を占めるにすぎず、NK細胞も同様であった。ランゲルハンス細胞は同定されなかった。貪食性マクロファージは抗原提示性マクロファージの2倍認められたが、Tリンパ球は抗原提示性マクロファージより15倍多かった。
